platform.description: Player platform. The accepted values depend on the instance's game: Minecraft accepts `java`/`bedrock`. Games with no restriction configured (Kerbal, Hytale) accept any platform. Terraria identifies players by Steam, which the server cannot resolve, so its roster is unavailable and every platform returns `400`. Sending a platform the game doesn't support returns `400`.

name.description: Typed gamertag/username. The server resolves it against the platform's API into the canonical `identifier`; `identifier` cannot be sent by the client.

schema.description: Partial update — send `access`, `privileged`, or both. At least one property is required; an empty body returns `400`. `platform`, `name` and `identifier` are immutable and rejected if sent.
